react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning still emitted: `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents`. Reference: /app/frontend/app/pairing/[id].tsx (off-screen share-card wrapper) — move pointerEvents:'none' into the style object. Was already reported in iteration_2.json but not yet fixed.

action_items: (Cosmetic, carried from iter2) In /app/frontend/app/pairing/[id].tsx, migrate the off-screen wrapper `<View style={styles.offscreen} pointerEvents="none">` to include `pointerEvents:'none'` inside the style object to silence the RN Web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~815 lines — still under the 700-line soft limit is exceeded; consider splitting AI (LLM + image gen), chat streaming and PayPal handlers into their own modules for maintainability. Not blocking.

generate_food_image() session_id uses `abs(hash(subject)) % 10**8` — Python hash randomisation makes this non-stable across processes; fine because the DB `image_b64` cache is authoritative, but a stable hash (hashlib) would let LLM providers dedupe as well.

chat_send streams the assistant reply but the persistence only happens after the stream closes. If the client disconnects mid-stream, the assistant message is lost while the user message is already saved — leaves a lopsided history. Consider persisting incrementally or on cancel.
used_today() uses `{'$regex': '^YYYY-MM-DD'}` on the created_at ISO string — works, but a proper date-range query on an indexed field would be faster once volume grows. Non-blocking.
compress_image swallows failures and returns the raw PNG b64 — good defensive behaviour.
